whatsappMessage:
Hi Gladiators Team,

I noticed your fitness center has exceptional 5.0★ reviews with 129+ happy clients in Kankarbagh, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://gladiators.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Gladiators Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness center (GLADIATORS) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your top-rated training in Kankarbagh, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
